BHAKTA KAVI NARSINH MEHTA UNIVERSITY
JUNAGADH
Notification No.BKNMU/3/2025
Bhakta Kavi Narsinh Mehta University invites Online Applications for Regular Recruitment for the
following Scientific and Non-Scientific posts for the Centre of Excellence for Wildlife and Conservation
Studies:
SN Type of Post Name of the Post No. of
Posts
1 Scientific Post Director 1
2 Scientific Post Scientist-D 1
3 Scientific Post Scientist-C 1
4 Non-Scientific Post Technical Assistant 1
5 Non-Scientific Post Office Assistant 1
Date of Commencement of Online Application 04/08/2025
Last date for Online Application 24/08/2025
Last date of receipt of hardcopy of online application
along with all enclosures 26/08/2025
Candidates are advised to visit Recruitment Portal www.bknmu.edu.in for details of Minimum
qualifications, experience, pay, general terms & conditions and other details before applying
online. Applications received after due date will not be considered.
Date: 01/08/2025 I/c Registrar
Page 2 of 10
Notification No.3/2025
Date: 01/08/2025
Bhakta Kavi Narsinh Mehta University- Junagadh
Direct Recruitment of Staff for the Centre of Excellence for Wildlife and
Conservation Studies
Details of posts, essential qualification and experience
1. Director
Pay scale: 144200-218200 (Pay matrix level 14)
Qualification and Experience:
Essential:
Doctorate degree from a recognized University or Institute in any of the disciplines of
Biological sciences.
And
1) Twenty years’ experience in teaching, research and development in university, or
science and technology organizations of Government, out of which at least five years
shall be in administration, planning, development of new, innovative science and
technology programme.
2) Experience of evolving, managing and directing science and technology academic and
research programme; and
3) Experience of collaborative research and development in the field of wildlife and
conservation biology
4) Published research work of high standard as prescribed by the UGC for the post of
Professor
a. Desirable:
Post Doctorate degree from a recognized University or Institute in the field of
wildlife and conservation biology;
Note: Only the experience acquired after obtaining the minimum essential educational
qualification shall count towards experience. Total period spent on post doctorate
research whether in a single or multiple field(s) or whether from a single or multiple
University/Universities or Research Institute(s) as evidenced by certification by such
University/Universities or Institute(s) and publication of research work in journals of
repute, subject to maximum of two years, shall be counted as experience.
Page 3 of 10
2. Scientist “D”
Pay scale: 78800-209200 (Pay matrix level 12)
Essential:
i. Master’s degree from a recognized University or Institute in any of the disciplines
of biological sciences.
OR
Bachelor’s Degree (minimum 4 years degree course) from a recognized
University or Institute in any of the disciplines of biological sciences.
ii. Eight years’ experience in research and development in industrial and academic
Institution or science and technology organizations or scientific activities and
services. OR Ministerial/ Administrative experience in Science/ Technology/
Higher Education services (all evident by respective certificates and publications)
Note: Only the experience acquired after obtaining the minimum essential
educational qualification shall count towards experience. Period spent on obtaining
doctorate degree (in the field of Essential Qualification) from a recognized
University or Institute, as evidenced by certification by such University or Institute,
subject to completion of the doctorate degree and subject to a maximum of two years
shall count towards experience. The period spent on pursuing doctorate degree shall
not count towards experience for any purpose, if the doctorate degree has not been
awarded. Total period spent on post-doctorate research whether in a single or
multiple field(s) or whether from a single or multiple University /Universities or
Research Institute(s) as evidenced by certification by such University/Universities
or Institute(s) and publication of research work in journals of repute, subject to
maximum of two years, shall be counted as experience.
3. Scientist “C”
Pay scale: 67700-208700 (Pay matrix level 11)
Essential:
i. Master’s degree from a recognized University or Institute in any of the disciplines of
biological sciences;
OR
Bachelor’s Degree (minimum 4 years degree course) from a recognized University
or Institute in any of the disciplines of biological sciences.
ii. Three years’ experience in Research and Development in Industrial and Academic
Page 4 of 10
Institutions OR Science and Technology Organization and Scientific activities and
services OR 3 years of administrative experience in Science/ Technology Department
OR 3 years of administrative experience in Any Government Department. (All evident
by respective certificates and publications)
4. Technical Assistant
Pay scale: 35400-112400 (Pay matrix level 6)
Educational and other qualifications required for direct recruits—
Essential:
Master’s degree from a recognized University or Institute in any of the disciplines of
biological sciences.
Desirable:
i. Doctorate degree from a recognized University or Institute in any of the disciplines
of biological sciences;
and
ii. Specialized experience in Remote sensing, GIS, Designing and Data management
in Institutional or Science and Technology Organizations.
5. Office Assistant
Pay scale: 19900-63200 (Pay Metrix level 2)
Essential:
Bachelor’s degree from a recognized University or Institute.
Desirable:
Graduation in Science, specialized experience in office work, internet, communication
in English, handling socials and public relations.
Disciplines of Biological science and subjects thereunder:
Discipline 1. Relevant subjects
Biological Sciences2. Biology
3. Botany
4. Zoology
5. Microbiology
6. Biotechnology
7. Life Sciences
8. Biochemistry
Page 5 of 10
9. Marine biology
Ecology
Conservation biology
Wildlife Sciences/ Biology
Environmental Sciences
Forestry
Ecology
Veterinary biology
Agriculture sciences
Any other relevant discipline with qualifying degree
which mentions ‘Biology or Biotechnology’ as the main
discipline
Age limit for direct recruits:
The upper age limit for direct recruits in each category of posts shall be as under:
Sl. No. Name of post Age limit
1. Scientist ‘C’ 35 years
2. Scientist ‘D’ 40 years
3. Scientist ‘G’ 55 years
4. Technical Assistant 35 years
5. Office Assistant 35 Years
(Relaxation for Government servants up to five years)
GENERAL INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The Candidate must apply online. Only online application with required uploaded
enclosures will be accepted.
2. Last date for the online application is 24/08/2025.
3. The applicant must send two hard copies of the application along with all self-attested
testimonials, certificates and all supporting documents relating to the post wherever
required on or before Dt. 26/08/2025 up to 06:10 p.m. to the University through
Courier/in Person/Registered Post/Speed Post to “The Registrar, Bhakta Kavi Narsinh
Mehta University, Government Polytechnic Campus, Bhakta Kavi Narsinh Mehta
University Road, Khadiya, Junagadh-362263 or else the application will not be
considered.
Page 6 of 10
4. Processing fees of Rs. 1000/- (Rs.500/- in case of candidates belonging to
SC/ST/SEBC/EWS/PH) should be paid through online mode.
5. Application fee once paid will not be refundable under any circumstances.
6. Candidates must produce original testimonials, certificates and other documents at the
time of interview, if called.
7. Application sent through email will not be entertained.
8. Candidates are advised to submit the application to the University well in advance
without waiting for the last date to avoid postal delay or any delay due to other
unforeseen events or circumstances. The University will not be responsible for any
postal delay at any stage.
9. Candidates who desire to apply for more than one post will be required to submit
separate online applications on the prescribed format along with all the specified
supporting documents and additional application processing fee along with each
application.
10. Please write Application for the post of “__________________”on the top of the
envelope.
11. Bhakta Kavi Narsinh Mehta University, Junagadh reserves all rights whether to fill up
or not, any or all the vacancies advertised and also to make any
amendments/modifications regarding eligibility criteria and required experiences as per
Government of Gujarat/Government of India rules and
Act/Statutes/Ordinances/Authorities of the University.
12. If a vacancy of Class-III falls under the direct‐recruitment quota, it shall be filled in
accordance with the Finance Department’s Fixed-Pay Policy, in force since 16th
February 2006, and the pay scales and conditions prescribed by the Finance
Department’s resolution dated 28th March 2016, together with all subsequent
amendments thereto.
13. The candidate appointed through direct recruitment shall, after receiving regular
appointment, be covered under the New Defined Contributory Pension Scheme
introduced by the State Government from 1st April 2005, as per the provisions of the
Finance Department's Resolution No.: NPN/2003/G.O.I./10 (P.F.A.) dated 18th March
2005.
14. Application should be submitted as per given online proforma only. Incomplete/without
attaching necessary testimonials/without online payment of prescribed fees or
application received after last date would be rejected.
Page 7 of 10
15. Candidate should possess the required educational qualifications and experience on the
prescribed last date of online submission of application.
16. The candidate should produce the experience certificate indicating the designation,
nature of employment (permanent etc), duration of experience, Pay Scale/Consolidated
Salary and a Certification to the effect that the appointment has been made through
proper selection procedure as per relevant regulations/Gujarat
Government/Government of India Rules. Such certificate should be signed with date
by the competent authority on the letter-head of the institution. Further Experience will
be validated based on the designation and appropriate salary grade pay (as per submitted
last month's salary slip).
17. The experience gained as Daily Wager, Trainee, Honorary and Visiting Faculty cannot
be considered as experience.
18. Any Corrigendum / Addendum for any further information and or update shall be
uploaded only on the website of the BKNMU, Junagadh.
19. The University reserves the right to short-list the candidates on the merit-based/aptitude
test/written test criteria or any other method for the purpose of inviting the candidates
for interview. The decision of Bhakta Kavi Narsinh Mehta University with regard to
the process of selection shall be final and binding to the candidates.
20. A salary certificate for the month of July,2025 showing pay scale, Grade Pay, D.A. and
other allowances being paid by your Institution/Office/Firm with authorized signature
should be enclosed with the application form and also be produced at the time of
interview for salaried person.
21. The reservations/relaxations policy for SC/ST/OBC/Divyangjan and other Candidates
will be provided as per the existing State Government rules.
22. Age relaxation will be provided as per the existing State Government/Government of
India rules.
23. Candidates in their own interest are advised to remain in touch with the University
website: www.bknmu.edu.in for updates.
24. The University shall verify the antecedents or documents submitted at any time, at the
time of appointment or during the tenure of the service. In case, it is found that any
document submitted is fake or the candidate has clandestine antecedents/background
and has suppressed the said information, his/her services shall be terminated forthwith.
25. Candidates already in employment in University, Educational Institutions, Government
Establishments and Organizations should forward their applications (hardcopy) through
Page 8 of 10
proper channel. In case the applicant is in service and delay is expected in getting
endorsement of the concerned employer on the original application, the applicant may
submit advance copy of the application along with all the enclosures directly (without
the employer's endorsement on the advance copy). If the original application through
proper channel has not been received on or before last date mentioned, the applicant
will have to submit a 'NO OBJECTION CERTIFICATE' from his/her employer to the
University at the time of interview
26. In case of any inadvertent mistake in the process of selection which may be detected at
any stage even after the issuance of appointment letter and/or after appointment, the
University reserves the right to modify/withdraw/cancel any communication made to
the candidates.
27. Age of superannuation for all the positions shall be as per Govt. of Gujarat/India norms.
28. Call letters and other correspondence for attending the interview, etc., will be sent to
the eligible candidates by email only or will be displayed on university website. So,
candidate should write his/her email ID very carefully.
29. In case of any dispute/ambiguity that may occur in the process of selection, the decision
of the Vice-Chancellor, Bhakta Kavi Narsinh Mehta University, Junagadh in all matter
relating to eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, mode of selection,
conduct of examination/ interview will be final and no query or correspondence will be
entertained in this connection from any individual or his/ her agency.
30. No T.A./D.A. will be paid to the candidate to attend written test/ interview.
31. Canvassing of any kind will not be tolerated and it will disqualify the candidature.
32. In case of any dispute, any sue or legal proceeding by or against the University, Courts
within whose local Jurisdiction, Headquarter of the University is situated shall have the
Jurisdiction.
33. However, the period of active service spent on pursuing Research Degree i.e. for
acquiring Ph.D. degree simultaneously without taking any kind of leave may be counted
as teaching/research experience for the purpose of direct recruitment / promotion to the
post of scientist and above.
34. Candidates shall enclose self-attested copies of certificates towards the evidence of
Age, Educational Qualifications, Caste, Physical Disability, Experience, etc. with the
applications without fail.
35. The candidate should produce formula/method of calculation of percentage where
percentage of marks is not given by the University.
Page 9 of 10
36. Applicants awarded degrees by Foreign Universities, shall be required to submit
Equivalence Certificate issued by Association of Indian University, New Delhi. The
University reserves the right to require Equivalence Certificate for various degrees from
any of the applicant.
37. A relaxation of 5% shall be provided, (from 55% to 50% of the marks) to the Ph.D.
Degree holders who have obtained their Master‘s Degree prior to19th September, 1991.
38. The qualifications and other conditions prescribed in the present advertisement are
subject to the regulations/norms stipulated as per the “Department of Science and
Technology of Government of India and Bhakta Kavi Narsinh Mehta University,
Junagadh and concerned statutory bodies as amended from time to time shall be binding
to the all candidates.
39. Appointed employees may be assigned other administrative responsibility in addition
to their research work.
40. The prescribed qualifications and experience are minimum and the mere fact that a
candidate possesses the same will not entitle him/her for being called for interview.
41. The University reserves the right to restrict the candidates to be called for interview to
a reasonable number on the basis of the scrutiny report.
42. Selection will be made on the basis of candidates’ overall record and/or performance in
the interview. The University may utilize seminar /colloquium and/or any other mode
as a method of selection.
43. The University reserves the right: a) To withdraw the advertisement either partly or
wholly at any time without assigning any reason to this effect. b) To fill or not to fill up
some or all the posts advertised for any reasons whatsoever. c) To increase/decrease the
number of posts d) Any edition/deletion and changes in matter of terms and conditions
given in this notification of recruitment, as directed by concerned authority/GoG/GoI
from time to time.
44. The University will not be responsible for any loss of e-mail, loss of any communication
due to wrong address provided by the candidates.
45. Fake/Derecognized Institutions: Candidates, who have obtained degrees or diplomas or
certificates for various courses from any Institution declared fake/derecognized by the
University Grants Commission, New Delhi shall not be eligible for being considered
for recruitment to the posts advertised.
46. In case of tie in the final merit list score, appropriate policy decided by the university /
selection committee shall be employed. And in case of any discrepancy in the above-
Page 10 of 10
mentioned guidelines, the decision of the university/selection committee shall be
considered as final.
47. For any technical query contact: 079-23238887 or support@gipl.net
Junagadh Registrar (I/c)
Date: 01/08/2025

is applicable
1. Valid address proof (Aadhar card/ Passport etc)
2. Valid caste certificate
3. Proof of age (Class X Pass Certificate/School Leaving Certificate)
4. Certificate in support of claim of age relaxation (if applicable)
5. Education qualifications (Mark sheets of Class X, Class XII, Bachelor, Master
degree & Ph.D. etc.) certificate, if applicable)
6. Experience certificates
7. Best Five Full Research Publications for all scientific posts
8. NCC/ NSS/ Sports/ Nature club/ Co-curricular activity certificates (if any)
9. Employment details (if applicable)
10. Salary Certificate
11. NOC (if applicable)
12. Documentary support for any other claim(s) made (if applicable)
